Hi Maya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of needs (as I captured them)
- Primary objective: reduce inference cost on your customer-facing assistant while keeping P95 latency <200ms for mid-sized queries (~350 tokens).
- Data constraints: must keep logs <90 days, and model responses cannot be persisted in third-party analytics without opt-in.
- Traffic profile: steady daytime traffic on US-East, spike expected after feature launch in May.

What Redwood would propose initially
- Pilot: Dedicated pool (2x A10G equiv.) + prefix caching for core intents, 6-week pilot to validate latency and cost.
- Deliverables: pilot runbook, POA for data handling (KMS/HSM options), and a brief cost/latency dashboard for expected unit economics.

Open questions / your confirmations
1) Is the pilot timeline (targeting mid-April launch) still accurate?
2) Who should I loop for procurement / security review? (you mentioned a security contact and procurement email on the call)
3) Any must-have integrations for SSO/KMS we should include in the scope?

Next steps
- I’ll send the discovery notes and a one-pager with the pilot scope attached.
- If this looks good, can we tentatively schedule a 30-minute alignment with your security contact the week of Mar 15? You can pick a time here: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Attachments: Discovery_Notes_AishaTech_03012026.pdf (summary), Suggested_Pricing_anchors.xlsx (ballpark pricing tiers)

Thanks — I’ll follow up in a few days if I don’t hear back.
